139: /// the thread token identifies a thread of a given replica
140: ///
141: ///  - Dafny: linear datatype ThreadOwnedContext
142: pub struct ThreadToken<DT: Dispatch> {
143:     /// the replica id this thread uses
144:     pub  /* REVIEW: (crate) */
145:      rid: ReplicaToken,
146:     /// identifies the thread within the replica
147:     pub  /* REVIEW: (crate) */
148:      tid: ThreadId,
149:     /// the flat combiner client of the thread
150:     pub fc_client: Tracked<FlatCombiner::clients>,

155: impl<DT: Dispatch> ThreadToken<DT> {
156:     pub open spec fn wf2(&self, num_replicas: nat) -> bool {
157:         &&& self.rid.wf(num_replicas)
158:         &&& self.fc_client@.value().is_Idle()
159:         &&& (self.tid as nat)
160:             < MAX_THREADS_PER_REPLICA
161:         // &&& self.fc_client@@.instance == fc_inst
162: 
163:         &&& self.batch_perm@.mem_contents().is_uninit()
164:         &&& self.fc_client@.key() == self.tid as nat
165:     }

167:     pub open spec fn wf(&self, replica: &Replica<DT>) -> bool {
168:         &&& self.wf2(replica.spec_id() + 1)  // +1 here because ids got < replicas
169: 
170:         &&& self.rid@ == replica.spec_id()
171:         &&& self.fc_client@.instance_id() == replica.flat_combiner_instance@.id()
172:         &&& self.batch_perm@@.pcell == replica.contexts[self.thread_id_spec() as int].batch.0.id()

244: ///  - Rust:  pub(crate) struct Context<T, R, M>
245: ///
246: /// Note, in contrast to the Rust version, we just have a single outstanding operation
247: #[repr(align(128))]
248: pub struct Context<DT: Dispatch> {
249:     /// Array that will hold all pending operations to be appended to the shared
250:     /// log as well as the results obtained on executing them against a replica.
251:     ///
252:     /// This is protected by the `atomic` field.
253:     ///
254:     ///  - Dafny: linear cell: CachePadded<Cell<OpResponse>>
255:     ///  - Rust:  pub(crate) batch: [CachePadded<PendingOperation<T, R, M>>; MAX_PENDING_OPS],
256:     pub/*REVIEW: (crate)*/ batch: CachePadded<PCell<PendingOperation<DT>>>,
257: 
258:     /// The number of operations in this context, (just 0 or 1)
259:     ///
260:     ///  - Dafny: linear atomic: CachePadded<Atomic<uint64, ContextGhost>>,
261:     ///  - Rust:  N/A
262:     pub/*REVIEW: (crate)*/ atomic: CachePadded<AtomicU64<_, ContextGhost<DT>, _>>,
263: 
264:     /// ghost: identifier of the thread
265:     pub thread_id_g: Ghost<nat>,
266: 
267:     pub flat_combiner_instance: Tracked<FlatCombiner::Instance>,
268:     pub unbounded_log_instance: Tracked<UnboundedLog::Instance<DT>>,
269: }

276:         &&& g.inv(v, thread_id_g@, batch.0, flat_combiner_instance@, unbounded_log_instance@)

281: impl<DT: Dispatch> Context<DT> {
282:     pub fn new(
283:         thread_id: usize,
284:         slot: Tracked<FlatCombiner::slots>,
285:         flat_combiner_instance: Tracked<FlatCombiner::Instance>,
286:         unbounded_log_instance: Tracked<UnboundedLog::Instance<DT>>,
287:     ) -> (res: (Context<DT>, Tracked<PointsTo<PendingOperation<DT>>>))

289:             slot@.value().is_Empty(),

300:         proof {
301:             thread_id_g = thread_id as nat;
302:         }
303:         // create the storage for storing the update operation
304:         let (batch, batch_perms) = PCell::empty();
305:         let batch = CachePadded(batch);
306:         // create the atomic with the ghost context
307:         let tracked context_ghost = ContextGhost {
308:             batch_perms: None,
309:             slots: slot.get(),
310:             update: Option::None,
311:         };
312:         let atomic = CachePadded(
313:             AtomicU64::new(
314:                 Ghost((flat_combiner_instance, unbounded_log_instance, batch, Ghost(thread_id_g))),
315:                 0,
316:                 Tracked(context_ghost),
317:             ),
318:         );
319:         // Assemble the context, return with the permissions
320:         (
321:             Context {
322:                 batch,
323:                 atomic,
324:                 thread_id_g: Ghost(thread_id_g),
325:                 flat_combiner_instance,
326:                 unbounded_log_instance,
327:             },
328:             batch_perms,
329:         )
330:     }

332:     /// Enqueues an operation onto this context's batch of pending operations.
333:     ///
334:     /// This is invoked by the thread that want's to execute an operation
335:     ///
336:     /// Note, enqueue is a bit a misnomer. We just have one operation per thread
337:     pub fn enqueue_op(
338:         &self,
339:         op: DT::WriteOperation,
340:         context_ghost: Tracked<FCClientRequestResponseGhost<DT>>,
341:     ) -> (res: (bool, Tracked<FCClientRequestResponseGhost<DT>>))
342:         requires
343:             context_ghost@.enqueue_op_pre(
344:                 self.thread_id_g@,
345:                 op,
346:                 self.batch.0.id(),
347:                 self.flat_combiner_instance@,
348:                 self.unbounded_log_instance@,
349:             ),
350:             self.wf(self.thread_id_g@),
351:         ensures
352:             res.1@.enqueue_op_post(context_ghost@),
353:             res.1@.cell_id == self.batch.0.id(),
354:             self.wf(self.thread_id_g@),
355:     {
356:         let tracked FCClientRequestResponseGhost {
357:             batch_perms: batch_perms,
358:             cell_id,
359:             local_updates: local_updates,
360:             fc_clients: mut fc_clients,
361:         } = context_ghost.get();
362:         let tracked mut batch_perms = batch_perms.tracked_unwrap();
363:         let tracked local_updates = local_updates.tracked_unwrap();
364:         // put the operation there, updates the permissions so we can store them in the GhostContext
365:         self.batch.0.put(Tracked(&mut batch_perms), PendingOperation::new(op));
366:         let tracked send_request_result;
367:         let res =
368:             atomic_with_ghost!(
369:             &self.atomic.0 => store(1);
370:             update prev->next;
371:             ghost g => {
372:                 let ghost tid = fc_clients.key();
373:                 let ghost rid = local_updates.key();
374: 
375:                 self.flat_combiner_instance.borrow().pre_send_request(tid, &fc_clients, &g.slots);
376:                 send_request_result = self.flat_combiner_instance.borrow().send_request(tid, rid, fc_clients, g.slots);
377:                 fc_clients = send_request_result.0.get();
378: 
379:                 g.slots = send_request_result.1.get();
380:                 g.batch_perms = Some(batch_perms);
381:                 g.update = Some(local_updates);

383:                 assert(g.inv(1, tid, self.batch.0, self.flat_combiner_instance.view(), self.unbounded_log_instance.view()))

387:             batch_perms: None,
388:             cell_id,
389:             local_updates: None,
390:             fc_clients,
391:         };
392:         (true, Tracked(new_context_ghost))
393:     }

395:     /// Returns a single response if available. Otherwise, returns None.
396:     ///

398:     pub fn dequeue_response(

412:     {

414:             batch_perms: mut batch_perms,
415:             cell_id,
416:             local_updates: mut local_updates,
417:             fc_clients: mut fc_clients,
418:         } = context_ghost.get();
419:         let tracked recv_response_result;

421:             atomic_with_ghost!(
422:             &self.atomic.0 => load();
423:             returning res;
424:             ghost g => {
425:                 if res == 0 {
426:                     batch_perms = g.batch_perms;
427:                     local_updates = g.update;

429:                     let tid = fc_clients.key();
430:                     let rid = fc_clients.value().get_Waiting_0();
431:                     self.flat_combiner_instance.borrow().pre_recv_response(tid, &fc_clients, &g.slots);
432:                     recv_response_result = self.flat_combiner_instance.borrow().recv_response(tid, rid, fc_clients, g.slots);
433:                     fc_clients = recv_response_result.0.get();
434: 
435:                     g.slots = recv_response_result.1.get();

439:             }
440:         );

513: ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
514: // Ghost Context
515: ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
516: struct_with_invariants!{
517: /// The ghost context for a thread carying permissions and tracking the state of the update operation
518: ///
519: ///  - Dafny:   glinear datatype ContextGhost = ContextGhost(
520: pub tracked struct ContextGhost<DT: Dispatch> {
521:     /// Token to access the batch cell in Context
522:     ///
523:     ///  - Dafny: glinear contents: glOption<CellContents<OpResponse>>,
524:     pub batch_perms: Option<PointsTo<PendingOperation<DT>>>,
525: 
526:     /// The flat combiner slot.
527:     ///
528:     ///  - Dafny: glinear fc: FCSlot,
529:     pub slots: FlatCombiner::slots,
530: 
531:     /// tracks the update operation
532:     ///
533:     ///  - Dafny: glinear update: glOption<Update>
534:     pub update: Option<UnboundedLog::local_updates<DT>>
535: }
536: 
537: //  - Dafny: predicate inv(v: uint64, i: nat, cell: Cell<OpResponse>, fc_loc_s: nat)
538: pub open spec fn inv(&self, v: u64, tid: nat, cell: PCell<PendingOperation<DT>>, fc: FlatCombiner::Instance, inst: UnboundedLog::Instance<DT>) -> bool {
539:     predicate {
540:         &&& self.slots.key() == tid
541:         &&& self.slots.instance_id() == fc.id()
542: 
543:         &&& ((v == 0) || (v == 1))
544:         &&& (v == 0 ==> self.slots.value().is_Empty() || self.slots.value().is_Response())
545:         &&& (v == 1 ==> self.slots.value().is_Request() || self.slots.value().is_InProgress())
546: 
547:         &&& (self.slots.value().is_Empty() ==> {
548:             &&& self.update.is_none()
549:             &&& self.batch_perms.is_none()
550:         })
551: 
552:         &&& (self.slots.value().is_Request() ==> {
553:             &&& self.update matches Some(update)
554:             &&& update.value().is_Init()
555:             &&& update.key() == self.slots.value().get_ReqId()
556:             &&& update.instance_id() == inst.id()
557: 
558:             &&& self.batch_perms matches Some(batch_perms)
559:             &&& batch_perms.mem_contents().is_init()
560:             &&& batch_perms@.pcell == cell.id()
561:             &&& batch_perms.mem_contents().value().op == update.value().get_Init_op()
562:         })
563: 
564:         &&& (self.slots.value().is_InProgress() ==> {
565:             &&& self.update.is_none()

1676:     /// Advances the head of the log forward. If a replica has stopped making
1677:     /// progress, then this method will never return. Accepts a closure that is
1678:     /// passed into execute() to ensure that this replica does not deadlock GC.
1679:     #[inline(always)]
1680:     #[verifier::exec_allows_no_decreases_clause]
1681:     fn advance_head(
1682:         &self,
1683:         replica_token: &ReplicaToken,
1684:         // the following were part of the closure
1685:         responses: &mut Vec<DT::Response>,
1686:         actual_replica: &mut DT,
1687:         // ghost state for execute etc.
1688:         ghost_data: Tracked<NrLogAppendExecDataGhost<DT>>,
1689:     ) -> (res: Tracked<NrLogAppendExecDataGhost<DT>>)
1690:         requires
1691:             self.wf(),
1692:             replica_token.wf(self.num_replicas@),
1693:             ghost_data@.advance_head_pre(
1694:                 replica_token.id_spec(),
1695:                 old(actual_replica).view(),
1696:                 old(responses)@,
1697:                 self.unbounded_log_instance@,
1698:                 self.cyclic_buffer_instance@,
1699:             ),
1700:         ensures
1701:             res@.advance_head_post(
1702:                 ghost_data@,
1703:                 replica_token.id_spec(),
1704:                 final(actual_replica).view(),
1705:                 final(responses)@,
1706:                 self.unbounded_log_instance@,
1707:                 self.cyclic_buffer_instance@,
1708:             ),
1709:     {
1710:         let mut ghost_data_new = ghost_data;
1711:         let mut iteration = 1;
1712:         loop
1713:             invariant
1714:                 self.wf(),
1715:                 replica_token.wf(self.num_replicas@),
1716:                 ghost_data_new@.cb_combiner@.value().is_Idle(),
1717:                 ghost_data_new@.combiner@.value().is_Placed() ==> ghost_data_new@.pre_exec(
1718:                     responses@,
1719:                 ),
1720:                 ghost_data_new@.advance_head_post(
1721:                     ghost_data@,
1722:                     replica_token.id_spec(),
1723:                     actual_replica.view(),
1724:                     responses@,
1725:                     self.unbounded_log_instance@,
1726:                     self.cyclic_buffer_instance@,
1727:                 ),
1728:                 0 <= iteration <= WARN_THRESHOLD,
1729:         {
1730:             let Tracked(ghost_data0) = ghost_data_new;
1731:             let tracked NrLogAppendExecDataGhost {
1732:                 local_updates,
1733:                 ghost_replica,
1734:                 combiner,
1735:                 cb_combiner,
1736:                 request_ids,
1737:             } = ghost_data0;
1738:             let tracked mut cb_combiner = cb_combiner.get();
1739:             // let global_head = self.head.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
1740:             let global_head =
1741:                 atomic_with_ghost!(
1742:                 &self.head.0 => load();
1743:                 returning ret;
1744:                 ghost g => { /* no-op */ }
1745:             );
1746:             // let f = self.tail.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
1747:             let global_tail =
1748:                 atomic_with_ghost!(
1749:                 &self.tail.0 => load();
1750:                 returning ret;
1751:                 ghost g => { /* no-op */ }
1752:             );
1753:             let (min_local_version, cb_combiner0) = self.find_min_local_version(
1754:                 Tracked(cb_combiner),
1755:             );
1756:             let tracked mut cb_combiner = cb_combiner0.get();
1757:             // If we cannot advance the head further, then start
1758:             // from the beginning of this loop again. Before doing so, try consuming
1759:             // any new entries on the log to prevent deadlock.
1760:             if min_local_version == global_head {
1761:                 proof {
1762:                     cb_combiner =
1763:                     self.cyclic_buffer_instance.borrow().advance_head_abort(
1764:                         replica_token.id_spec(),
1765:                         cb_combiner,
1766:                     );
1767:                 }
1768:                 if iteration == WARN_THRESHOLD {
1769:                     print_starvation_warning(line!());
1770:                     // let tracked cb_combiner = Tracked(cb_combiner);
1771:                     // let tracked ghost_data = NrLogAppendExecDataGhost { local_updates, ghost_replica, combiner, cb_combiner, request_ids };
1772:                     // return Tracked(ghost_data);
1773:                     iteration = 0;
1774:                 }
1775:                 let cb_combiner = Tracked(cb_combiner);
1776:                 let tracked ghost_data0 = NrLogAppendExecDataGhost {
1777:                     local_updates,
1778:                     ghost_replica,
1779:                     combiner,
1780:                     cb_combiner,
1781:                     request_ids,
1782:                 };
1783:                 ghost_data_new =
1784:                 self.execute(replica_token, responses, actual_replica, Tracked(ghost_data0));
1785:                 continue ;
1786:             }
1787:             // There are entries that can be freed up; update the head offset.
1788:             // self.head.store(min_local_tail, Ordering::Relaxed);
1789: 
1790:             atomic_with_ghost!(
1791:                 &self.head.0 => store(min_local_version);
1792:                 update old_val -> new_val;
1793:                 ghost g => {
1794:             });
1795:             if global_tail < min_local_version + self.slog.len() as u64 - GC_FROM_HEAD as u64 {
1796:                 let cb_combiner = Tracked(cb_combiner);
1797:                 let tracked ghost_data_new = NrLogAppendExecDataGhost {
1798:                     local_updates,
1799:                     ghost_replica,
1800:                     combiner,
1801:                     cb_combiner,
1802:                     request_ids,
1803:                 };
1804:                 return Tracked(ghost_data_new);
1805:             }
1806:             let cb_combiner = Tracked(cb_combiner);
1807:             let tracked ghost_data0 = NrLogAppendExecDataGhost {
1808:                 local_updates,
1809:                 ghost_replica,
1810:                 combiner,
1811:                 cb_combiner,
1812:                 request_ids,
1813:             };
1814:             // replica_token@ < self.local_versions.len(),
1815:             ghost_data_new =
1816:             self.execute(replica_token, responses, actual_replica, Tracked(ghost_data0));
1817:         }
1818:     }

1820:     /// proof function that transitions local updates into the done state.
1821:     proof fn execute_update_done_multiple(
1822:         tracked &self,
1823:         request_ids: Seq<ReqId>,
1824:         tracked local_updates: Map<nat, UnboundedLog::local_updates<DT>>,
1825:         tracked version_upper_bound: &UnboundedLog::version_upper_bound<DT>,
1826:     ) -> (tracked res: Map<nat, UnboundedLog::local_updates<DT>>)
1827:         requires
1828:             self.wf(),
1829:             version_upper_bound.instance_id() == self.unbounded_log_instance@.id(),
1830:             forall|i|
1831:                 #![trigger local_updates[i]]
1832:                 0 <= i < request_ids.len() ==> {
1833:                     &&& #[trigger] local_updates.contains_key(i)
1834:                     &&& local_updates[i].key() == request_ids[i as int]
1835:                     &&& local_updates[i].instance_id() == self.unbounded_log_instance@.id()
1836:                     &&& local_updates[i].value().is_Applied()
1837:                     &&& local_updates[i].value().get_Applied_idx() < version_upper_bound.value()
1838:                 },
1839:         ensures
1840:             forall|i|
1841:                 #![trigger res[i]]
1842:                 0 <= i < request_ids.len() ==> {
1843:                     &&& #[trigger] res.contains_key(i)
1844:                     &&& res[i].key() == request_ids[i as int]
1845:                     &&& res[i].instance_id() == self.unbounded_log_instance@.id()
1846:                     &&& res[i].value().is_Done()
1847:                     &&& res[i].value().get_Done_ret() == local_updates[i].value().get_Applied_ret()
1848:                 },
1849:         decreases request_ids.len(),
1850:     {
1851:         if request_ids.len() == 0 {
1852:             return local_updates;
1853:         }
1854:         let tracked mut local_updates_new = local_updates;
1855:         let idx = (request_ids.len() - 1) as nat;
1856:         let tracked local_update = local_updates_new.tracked_remove(idx);
1857:         local_updates_new =
1858:         self.execute_update_done_multiple(
1859:             request_ids.subrange(0, request_ids.len() - 1),
1860:             local_updates_new,
1861:             version_upper_bound,
1862:         );
1863:         let tracked update_done_result = self.unbounded_log_instance.borrow().update_done(
1864:             request_ids.last(),
1865:             version_upper_bound,
1866:             local_update,
1867:         );
1868:         local_updates_new.tracked_insert(idx, update_done_result);
1869:         return local_updates_new;
1870:     }

3115:     /// Performs one round of flat combining. Collects, appends and executes operations.
3116:     fn combine(
3117:         &self,
3118:         slog: &NrLog<DT>,
3119:         combiner_lock: Tracked<CombinerLockStateGhost<DT>>,
3120:     ) -> (result: Tracked<CombinerLockStateGhost<DT>>)
3121:         requires
3122:             self.wf(),
3123:             slog.wf(),
3124:             slog.unbounded_log_instance@ == self.unbounded_log_instance@,
3125:             slog.cyclic_buffer_instance@ == self.cyclic_buffer_instance@,
3126:             combiner_lock@.inv(
3127:                 self.flat_combiner_instance@,
3128:                 self.responses.id(),
3129:                 self.collected_operations.id(),
3130:                 self.collected_operations_per_thread.id(),
3131:             ),
3132:         ensures
3133:             result@.inv(
3134:                 self.flat_combiner_instance@,
3135:                 self.responses.id(),
3136:                 self.collected_operations.id(),
3137:                 self.collected_operations_per_thread.id(),
3138:             ),
3139:     {
3140:         // disassemble the combiner lock
3141:         let tracked combiner_lock = combiner_lock.get();
3142:         let flat_combiner = Tracked(combiner_lock.flat_combiner.get());
3143:         let tracked mut collected_operations_perm = combiner_lock.collected_operations_perm.get();
3144:         let tracked mut collected_operations_per_thread_perm =
3145:             combiner_lock.collected_operations_per_thread_perm.get();
3146:         let tracked mut responses_token = combiner_lock.responses_token.get();
3147:         // obtain access to the responses, operations and num_ops_per_thread buffers
3148:         let mut responses = self.responses.take(Tracked(&mut responses_token));
3149:         let mut operations = self.collected_operations.take(
3150:             Tracked(&mut collected_operations_perm),
3151:         );
3152:         // assert(self.collected_operations_per_thread.id() == collected_operations_per_thread_perm@.pcell);
3153:         let mut num_ops_per_thread = self.collected_operations_per_thread.take(
3154:             Tracked(&mut collected_operations_per_thread_perm),
3155:         );
3156:         // Step 1: collect the operations from the threads
3157:         // self.collect_thread_ops(&mut buffer, operations.as_mut_slice());
3158:         let Tracked(collect_res) = self.collect_thread_ops(
3159:             &mut operations,
3160:             &mut num_ops_per_thread,
3161:             flat_combiner,
3162:         );
3163:         let tracked ThreadOpsData { flat_combiner, local_updates, request_ids, cell_permissions } =
3164:             collect_res;
3165:         // Step 2: Take the R/W lock on the data structure
3166:         let (replicated_data_structure, write_handle) = self.data.0.acquire_write();
3167:         let mut data = replicated_data_structure.data;
3168:         let ghost_replica = replicated_data_structure.replica;
3169:         let combiner = replicated_data_structure.combiner;
3170:         let cb_combiner = replicated_data_structure.cb_combiner;
3171:         // let mut replicated_data_structure = self._data.0.write(MAX_THREADS_PER_REPLICA);
3172:         // let data = &mut replicated_data_structure.data;
3173:         // Step 3: Append all operations to the log
3174:         let tracked append_exec_ghost_data = NrLogAppendExecDataGhost {
3175:             local_updates,
3176:             ghost_replica,
3177:             combiner,
3178:             cb_combiner,
3179:             request_ids,
3180:         };
3181:         let append_exec_ghost_data = slog.append(
3182:             &self.replica_token,
3183:             &operations,
3184:             &mut responses,
3185:             &mut data,
3186:             Tracked(append_exec_ghost_data),
3187:         );
3188:         // TODO: release lock here! upstream does release the lock here and the reacquire it!
3189:         // drop(replicated_data_structure);
3190:         // Step 3: Execute all operations
3191:         let append_exec_ghost_data = slog.execute(
3192:             &self.replica_token,
3193:             &mut responses,
3194:             &mut data,
3195:             append_exec_ghost_data,
3196:         );
3197:         let Tracked(append_exec_ghost_data) = append_exec_ghost_data;
3198:         let tracked NrLogAppendExecDataGhost {
3199:             local_updates,
3200:             ghost_replica,
3201:             combiner,
3202:             cb_combiner,
3203:             request_ids,
3204:         } = append_exec_ghost_data;
3205:         let tracked ghost_replica = ghost_replica.get();
3206:         let tracked combiner = combiner.get();
3207:         let tracked cb_combiner = cb_combiner.get();
3208:         // Step 4: release the R/W lock on the data structure
3209:         let replicated_data_structure = ReplicatedDataStructure {
3210:             data,
3211:             replica: Tracked(ghost_replica),
3212:             combiner: Tracked(combiner),
3213:             cb_combiner: Tracked(cb_combiner),
3214:         };
3215:         self.data.0.release_write(replicated_data_structure, write_handle);
3216:         // Step 5: collect the results
3217:         let tracked thread_ops_data = ThreadOpsData {
3218:             flat_combiner,
3219:             request_ids,
3220:             local_updates,
3221:             cell_permissions,
3222:         };
3223:         let distribute_thread_resps_result = self.distribute_thread_resps(
3224:             &mut responses,
3225:             &mut num_ops_per_thread,
3226:             Tracked(thread_ops_data),
3227:         );
3228:         let tracked ThreadOpsData { flat_combiner, request_ids, local_updates, cell_permissions } =
3229:             distribute_thread_resps_result.get();
3230:         // clear the buffers again
3231:         responses.clear();
3232:         operations.clear();
3233:         num_ops_per_thread.clear();
3234:         // // place the responses back into the state
3235:         self.responses.put(Tracked(&mut responses_token), responses);
3236:         self.collected_operations.put(Tracked(&mut collected_operations_perm), operations);
3237:         self.collected_operations_per_thread.put(
3238:             Tracked(&mut collected_operations_per_thread_perm),
3239:             num_ops_per_thread,
3240:         );
3241:         // re-assemble the combiner lock
3242:         let tracked combiner_lock = CombinerLockStateGhost {
3243:             flat_combiner,
3244:             collected_operations_perm: Tracked(collected_operations_perm),
3245:             collected_operations_per_thread_perm: Tracked(collected_operations_per_thread_perm),
3246:             responses_token: Tracked(responses_token),
3247:         };
3248:         Tracked(combiner_lock)
3249:     }

4326:                     idx < self.ref_counts.len(),
